artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 5-hour plan: source_git_head stamping in state.lua plus a non-blocking check-deploy-freshness.sh WARN wired into command-gate-in.sh.

memory_candidates.content: When adding a check to a script that is SOURCED rather than executed (e.g. command-gate-in.sh, CHECKPOINT 1 in the agent-system), the new work must be invoked as `bash <script> || true` in a subprocess, never sourced, and the callee must exit 0 on every path. Sourcing propagates stray `exit`, `set -e`, and non-zero returns into the caller's shell, turning an advisory check into an abort of every command. Pair this with an existence guard on the callee, because a stale deploy tree may not contain the newly added script at all -- the same chicken-and-egg gap any deployed-artifact self-diagnostic has.
